# Bindery notebook

## Colors

Use ivory paper (#faf8ef), near-black ink (#27231f) and oxblood (#763740) for links, focus and the booking action.

## Typography

Use Georgia for the masthead, headings and reading text. Use system sans-serif for input labels and controls.

## Layout

Keep a single left-aligned reading column up to 42rem wide. Separate entries with a fine ink rule. Preserve the compact running masthead and the order of the reference entries.
